description: This file defines the 'Query' class in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library, providing static methods for parsing and building URL query strings.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for parsing query strings into arrays and constructing query strings from arrays.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a query string into an associative array, decoding values based on specified encoding rules.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a query string from an array of parameters, with options for encoding and boolean treatment.
